title: Genome builds and lift-over

blocks.what_we_do: Convert the separate GRCh37 exercise to GRCh38 with a direction-specific chain in R; keep it separate from the main analysis.
blocks.why: GRCh37 and GRCh38 are different reference assemblies. A coordinate means a chromosome and position in a specified assembly. Renaming the build label or changing an rsID does not transform coordinates. A chain records aligned genome intervals; lift-over can leave sites unmapped, change chromosome or reverse strand. UCSC intervals are zero-based half-open, whereas course positions are one-based. Review unmapped and reverse-strand sites instead of accepting an undocumented conversion.
blocks.you_need: The small GRCh37 exercise supplied at 0.5 and the official hg19-to-hg38 chain. The final course package must include the chain under grch37_exercise/. Author validation may set COURSE_CHAIN_FILE to the existing local chain. The main array is already GRCh38 and is not lifted again.
blocks.command:
```{r s2-6}
legacy <- file.path(cfg$data_dir, "grch37_exercise", "legacy_grch37")
bim37 <- read_ws(paste0(legacy, ".bim"), header = FALSE)
chain <- Sys.getenv("COURSE_CHAIN_FILE", unset = file.path(cfg$data_dir, "grch37_exercise", "hg19ToHg38.over.chain.gz"))
require_files(chain)
lifted <- guided_liftover(paste0("chr", bim37[[1]]), bim37[[4]], chain)
keep <- !is.na(lifted$position) & lifted$chromosome == paste0("chr", bim37[[1]])
map <- data.frame(ID = bim37[[2]][keep], POS = lifted$position[keep])
map_file <- guided_path(cfg, "2.6", "update_map.tsv")
write.table(map, map_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
keep_file <- guided_list(map$ID, guided_path(cfg, "2.6", "mapped.txt"))
args <- c("--bfile", legacy, "--extract", keep_file, "--update-map", map_file)
reverse <- bim37[[2]][keep & lifted$strand == "-"]
if (length(reverse)) args <- c(args, "--flip", guided_list(reverse, guided_path(cfg, "2.6", "reverse.txt")))
run_plink(cfg, c(args, "--make-pgen", "--out", guided_path(cfg, "2.6", "grch38")))
ann <- guided_table(file.path(cfg$data_dir, "array", "sim2026_array_annotation.tsv"))
k <- match(map$ID, ann$Name)
stopifnot(all(map$POS[!is.na(k)] == as.numeric(ann$Position_GRCh38[k[!is.na(k)]])))
print(c(input_sites = nrow(bim37), mapped_same_chromosome = sum(keep), reverse_strand = length(reverse)))
```

Plain PLINK 2 command (use `bin\plink2.exe` on Windows):

```sh
bin/plink2 --bfile data/course/grch37_exercise/legacy_grch37 --extract results/guided/s2-6_mapped.txt --update-map results/guided/s2-6_update_map.tsv --make-pgen --out results/guided/s2-6_grch38 --threads 2 --memory 2048
```

`--extract` retains the successfully mapped IDs; `--update-map` reads ID and new position from two columns. If the R calculation finds reverse-strand mappings, add `--flip` with the generated reverse list. The exercise retains same-chromosome mappings only and reports exclusions. `--out` sets the output prefix; `--threads 2` and `--memory 2048` bound resources. The R helper prints the exact command with your own safe paths.
blocks.expected_result:
10,000 exercise sites are inspected; 9,970 map to the same chromosome and eight of these reverse strand in this chain. The resulting exercise variants are not position-sorted; sort explicitly before an operation that requires sorted input. Mapped positions sharing an identifier with the course annotation agree with GRCh38. The main 296,510-site state from 2.5 is unchanged. General lift-over can lose sites, so record the reported mapping counts.

The tested PLINK version is defined in `config.R` and recorded in
`software_versions.txt`. Validation: executable chunks and available instructor reference counts passed on Windows.
blocks.troubleshooting: Stop at the first error. Check the named input and the previous step. Keep the command and console logs; do not substitute files from a different dataset version. See [troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting.md).
blocks.what_this_check_can_reveal: Build mismatches, gaps and reverse mappings. A chain is not an allele-validation or genotype-imputation tool.
blocks.quick_check:
Does a successful position lift-over guarantee that REF and ALT now match the destination reference?

<details><summary>Show the answer</summary>

No. Alleles and reverse-strand mappings still require checking.

</details>
blocks.files_created: `s2-6_update_map.tsv`, mapped/reverse lists and the separate `s2-6_grch38` fileset.

options.name: --bfile
options.explanation_markdown:
Terminal equivalent: `Rscript --vanilla scripts/preflight.R`. `--vanilla`
starts without saved workspaces and startup files. Internally the R helper
runs PLINK with `--bfile` (input BED/BIM/FAM prefix), `--autosome` (autosomal
sites), `--thin-count 20` (a small subset), `--seed 20261111` (repeatable sampling),
`--freq` (allele frequencies) and `--out` (output prefix). The exact command,
including your paths and resource settings, is printed and recorded.
